title: Choosing Credit Hold also locks Credit Limit at $0.00
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • Scenario: Your shop uses Net 30 as the default, and you put a new customer with a credit limit on Credit Hold.
  • You are an Admin user working at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Net 30 is the shop's default for new customers.
  • Starting screen: the Customers page.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click "New Customer".
  2. Type 750 in Credit Limit.
  3. Choose "Credit Hold" in Credit Terms.
  4. Hover Credit Limit.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the "New Customer" window opens.
  • Step 2: Credit Limit reads 750.
  • Step 3: Credit Limit changes to $0.00 and is disabled.
  • Step 4: the hover reads "COD and Credit Hold customers can't charge to account, so they have no credit limit."

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11674 (Story 5, New Customer and Edit Customer)

  • S5-R4: “When the chosen term is COD or Credit Hold, Credit Limit shows $0.00 and is disabled; hovering it shows "COD and Credit Hold customers can't charge to account, so they have no credit limit." Choosing COD or Credit Hold sets the limit to $0.00.”
  • Key Decisions: “COD and Credit Hold customers have a $0 credit limit that cannot be changed, in New Customer and Edit Customer, and imports and the Public API save them with $0 (S10-R6, S10-R8).”
